description: The Functional Mock-up Interface defines a standard container and interface for exchanging dynamic simulation models. It specifies XML, binary and C-code elements and supports model exchange and co-simulation across implementing tools. The resource is documented by Modelica Association FMI Project. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The documentation is publicly accessible. Licence: Free specification; the exact redistribution licence was not checked. Access is described as free. A supported FMI version does not by itself guarantee equivalent numerical behaviour across tools. No FMU was downloaded or executed. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. It is related to platform-openmodelica in this catalogue.
